description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade functions for Mikrotik devices running OpenWrt, including functions to check image validity, perform NAND upgrades, and select appropriate upgrade procedures based on device model.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Simple function that always returns success, likely a placeholder or simple validation.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_mikrotik_nand
methods.description: Handles the firmware upgrade process for Mikrotik devices with NAND flash, extracting kernel from the image and writing it to the appropriate partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Selects the appropriate upgrade procedure based on the device's model identifier, or performs a generic or NOR device upgrade if no specific match.
